title: Chapter 2 Building A Shelter
content:
Chapter 2 Building A Shelter

There was a "pop" sound.

The "Survivor's Manual" in his hand fell to the ground.

"This can't be true!" He swallowed unconsciously, a little unbelievable.

He was really frightened.

At this time, Wang Shuo was like a deflated rubber ball. The lofty ambition that had just risen disappeared in an instant.

He even felt that there was a huge haze that enveloped him; it was as if an invisible hand was strangling his neck, and even his breathing was a little unsmooth.

After calming down, he picked up the manual and read this passage several times.

"Why the hell can't I survive the first night?" Wang Shuo expressed dissatisfaction.

But I would rather believe that it exists than believe that it does not exist.

"You must be fully prepared and do your best to fight against this damn 'diary prophecy'. It is not my style to surrender without mercy. I will never give in until the last moment of death."

He said to himself with a firm look on his face, as if to cheer himself up.

There are also 2 sticks, 2 leaves, 4 ropes, and 5 stones in the backpack. This is all his current resources.

Wang Shuo planned to build some basic tools first, so that he could sharpen his sword and chop wood. With the tools, he could collect materials better.

Open [Synthesis Formula].

There are many items that can be manufactured on it, but most of them are tools based on stone and wood.

"Are we supposed to start from the Stone Age?" Wang Shuo wondered.

Wang Shuo couldn't help but feel a chill as he imagined the primitive man's life of eating hair, drinking blood, and drilling wood to make fire.

Click on the first "stone axe" and immediately get the system prompt:

[Stone ax = 1 stick + 1 stone + 1 rope]

(The most basic logging tool, attack power: 5, durability 5/5, a must-have artifact for cutting trees, an ax in hand, I have the wood.)

(Note: 1 stone = 10 stone flakes = 10 stones (gravel))

He clicked on the "Stone Knife" again.

[Stone knife = 1 wooden stick + 1 stone chip + 1 rope]

…

After reading it, he no longer hesitated and silently thought about making a "stone axe".

[Stone ax: stick 2/1, stone 2/1, rope 4/1]

[Are you sure you want to make a stone axe? 】

"yes."

[Wooden stick-1, stone-1, rope-1]

[Please wait patiently for 1 minute. 】

One minute passed quickly.

[Stone Ax +1]

Suddenly there was a stone ax in the backpack, and the system prompt sounded again:

[Due to your explosive character, you have obtained an excellent stone axe, with durability +1 and attack power +3. 】

[Excellent stone axe: attack power: 8, durability 6/6. 】

"And such good things."

The outburst of character made Wang Shuo feel a little better.

"But am I so European? The winning lottery tickets don't cost more than 10 yuan." Wang Shuo was a little worried, whether he had gone too far!

The remaining materials can be used to make another stone knife.

He also made it by the way.

[Stone Knife +1]

Seeing the branches and leaves on the ground scattered randomly everywhere, Wang Shuo quickly started to collect them. [Twigs +1, 10 branches can be combined into 1 wooden stick]

[Twig +1]

…

In about one cigarette, Wang Shuo got 6 units of sticks and 5 units of leaves.

Not only that, there are 28 units of "withered grass" in the backpack.

When he picked up the first piece of dead grass, the system reminded him that 10 units of dead grass can be synthesized into 1 unit of rope.

In the same way, 10 units of sticks can be synthesized into 1 unit of wood, but this kind of wood is called "low-quality wood" and cannot be used to upgrade the shack.

I don’t know if other players will have the urge to curse after getting this information, but Wang Shuo has it anyway.

At this moment, the system prompt sounded again:

[Shelter construction completed]

[Shack: Durability 10/10, the simplest shelter, with such simple materials and such simple craftsmanship, what can you expect from it. A heavy rain or strong wind can destroy it, or even a hard kick can cause it to fall apart. 】

Although just by hearing the name, one could tell that it was not a high-end product, the sight in front of him still surprised Wang Shuo.

Three crooked wooden sticks, propped up with edges, covered with branches and leaves.

"That's it, you call it a shelter."

Wang Shuo felt so cold in his heart that he felt as if he had eaten a fly.

When I walked in, I saw that the ground was also covered with leaves, and the space was very small, with only room for one person to lie down.

There was still a faint smell of rotting leaves in the air in the shack, which was very pungent.

Lying on the leaves, it was cold and there was no comfort at all.

"Even if I, Wang Shuo, freeze to death, I will not live in such a shack!"

Wang Shuo wanted to complain at this moment, so he tried the chat function and opened the [Chat Channel].

I was thinking in my mind: "Have your shelters been built?" while silently saying "Send".

At this time, his words appeared in the chat dialog box.

ID:5678 Wang Shuo: "Have your shelters been built?"

ID:2158 Zhang Xiaolian: "Dad, where are you? I want to go home."

ID: 3002 Wang Chen: "I just got married to my college goddess yesterday, and I was drunk on the wedding night. I didn't expect that now... Wuwuwu..."

ID:6547 Qian Jiang: "I built the shelter from the beginning. When I came here, I was about to get up to pee. At this moment, I only had a set of autumn clothes and long trousers on me. I was lying in the shack, and my teeth were chattering with the cold. I feel like I'm freezing to death."

ID:3610 Zhang Yang: "Sorry, I had diarrhea just now, and now my butt is frozen solid. I'm waiting online for paper delivery. Urgent!!!"

ID:4145 Zhang Hui: "For the sake of the family, I suggest that you don't use leaves on the ground upstairs. Don't ask me why, my butt is still bleeding now."

…

After studying the [Chat Channel] for a while, Wang Shuo found that you can choose to turn on or off the sound, and you can also choose to hide or display the ID and name.

"It's a very useful function." Wang Shuo pursed his lips and couldn't help but praise.

"What should I do if the heart of shelter falls?"

"Then you're dead!"

"Don't I know to pick it up?"

"I suggest you collect supplies quickly and upgrade your shack. I have already cut down a tree and obtained 10 units of wood."

"Brothers, my stone ax broke into pieces automatically after cutting down 2 trees. Do you have this problem? I used a low-quality stone axe."

"Brother, it's okay. I've knocked down 2 trees. The stone ax I used doesn't have the word "inferior" on it. The durability is 5. After killing 2 trees, the durability becomes 4/5."

"Is there any way to cut down trees without an axe? Cutting down trees is very tiring, and a stone ax will be useless after it can't cut down only a few trees."

"Do you want to masturbate with your hands upstairs?"

…

Seeing the conversation in the [Chat Channel], Wang Shuo silently took out a fine stone ax from his backpack and was in a good mood.

Suddenly, Wang Shuo thought of something and planned to ask the brothers in the channel again.

Wang Shuo: "Do you have words for the 'diary page' in your 'Survivor's Manual'?"

"I can write on mine!"

"I can write on mine too."

Zhang Yang: "@ ID:2888 Wang Yuyao, thank you sister for the hot water. I will repay you with the spring water. I will protect you from now on."

…

Seeing their answers, Wang Shuo was already sure that his 'diary pages' were different from theirs.

Wang Shuo felt a little uneasy in his heart. The contents of the "diary prophecy" cast a huge shadow on his journey of survival.

Exiting the [Chat Channel], he found that there were new changes in the [Task] column.

[Main Mission]: Survive to the end.

(The number of survivors in the current area: 9990/10000.)

Wang Shuo was shocked. Does this mean that 10 people have died?

Survival is stressful! ! !

[Side mission]

Please upgrade your shack to a wooden house (earth house, igloo) as soon as possible.

(Upgrade conditions: 100 wood/100 soil/100 ice + 10 stone.)

(Don’t think that you can survive tonight if you have a shack. You are thinking nonsense. Upgrading the wooden house is the way to go.)

Wang Shuo glanced at the shack with air leakage from all sides. How could it withstand the cold current below 0℃ at night?

The only serious thing is to collect enough materials to upgrade the shack as soon as possible.

But under the thick fog, it was impossible to tell the direction.

Once you leave the shelter, how to get back becomes a big problem.
